en.bdb: Result of the association of apostates

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੜੀਐ ਕਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ ਭਰੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: vaReeaai kajal koThaRee muh kaalakh bhareeaai|

en.bdb: If someone enters a room full of soot his face is sure to be blackened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੀ ਬੀਜੀਐ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਨਾ ਸਰੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: kalar khetee beejeeaai kih kaaj naa sareeaai|

en.bdb: If seed be sown in the alkaline field, that will go useless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਟੁਟੀ ਪੀਂਘੈ ਪੀਂਘੀਐ ਪੈ ਟੋਏ ਮਰੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: TuTee pee(n)ghai pee(n)gheeaai pai Toe mareeaai|

en.bdb: If somebody swings in a broken swing, he will fall and kill himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਨਾ ਫੜਿ ਮਨਤਾਰੂਆਂ ਕਿਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)naa faR manataarooaa(n) kiau dhutar tareeaai|

en.bdb: If a man who does not know how to swim, leans on the shoulders of another equally ignorant, how shall he cross a deep river?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿ ਲਾਇ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਸਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਫਰੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: ag lai ma(n)dhar savai tis naal na fareeaai|

en.bdb: Move not with him who sets fire to his own house and then goes to sleep.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉਂ ਠਗ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਖਹੁ ਡਰੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: tiau(n) Thag sa(n)gat bemukhaa(n) jeea jokhahu ddareeaai ||15||

en.bdb: Such is the society of the deceitful and apostates wherein man is ever in fear of his life.
